author: YaniSun

title: I Love It!
body: I love the app and it has helped me to advance at such an unbelievable level! I could have never imagined how much it changed my life for the better! If I had to think of one thing to improve, it would be an option to disable the numerical display of the health, EXP and mana. Thank you very much for creating such a great app!
author: Jasilol

title: Finally does what I need
body: I want something social, positive and negative rewards, different types of tasks (timed, non timed, repetitive, …) and Habitica has these. It’s fun. It has some little imperfections, but it works overall.
author: nt_st@b

title: Best App ever created
body: This is definitely the best app on earth. It really helps you to become a good person haha and it is really thought through! Well done!
author: Cüju

title: Just what I needed!
body: This app gives me everything I need to be motivated. It is such a great help! I wouldn't know what to do without it!

title: Love it
body: I absolutely love this app ! It is such a fun and original way of keeping up with everyday tasks and building better habits. Great work and keep going !
author: Zilsara

title: The Best!!
body: It‘s a really great concept, so I forgive gladly when the app sometimes lags.. the concept is really thought through, it‘s almost perfekt. What I miss is a way to priorise your to-do‘s.. the to do list is somewhat chaotic in my case😅
author: kPhooC

title: Lot of bugs
body:
Can’t see rewards from quests
Takes hours to validate actions
Shut down without noticing
It’s a shame because it’s a great idea, fun way to encourage to do all those tasks we push to next day

title: Stürzt oft ab
body: App an sich sehr schön gestaltet und hilft tatsächlich dir Alltagsaufgaben zu meistern. Jedoch stürzt die App auf dem iPhone 5s oft ab und wird teilweise nicht richtig angezeigt. Schade.

title: Crème de la Crème!
body: I started with HabitRPG since 2013 and since then i'm totally in love with the hole concept. Even more its a awesome community who push things further and further. The hole Habitica universe is full of passionated people, its every day a pleasure to do my tasks with Habitica!
